testPolicy.text: ACT/SAT scores are optional for all first-year applicants, including international students, homeschooled students and recruited athletes. The choice to apply test-optional cannot be changed after the application is submitted.

cost.totalIncludes: Office of Student Financial Aid cost-of-attendance tool, Fall 2026-Spring 2027, undergraduate starting fall 2026, 12+ credit hours, base rate (most LAS majors): tuition, fees, food and housing, books and supplies, other expenses. Tuition is higher in many programs: engineering, Gies business, astrophysics 18,740 in-state and 44,340 out-of-state (totals 43,480 and 69,420).

aidPromise.text: Illinois Commitment: Illinois residents admitted as new freshmen or transfers for fall 2025 or later whose family income is $75,000 or less and family assets $75,000 or less receive scholarship and grant funding covering the full cost of tuition and campus fees not covered by other awards, renewable for four years for freshmen. FAFSA due by March 15.

deadlines.early: November 1 (Early Action, non-binding, materials by November 7, notification January 29)

facts.text: Applicants apply to a specific major; if they are not admissible to their first choice they are reviewed for a second-choice major, and an admit to the second choice is wait listed for the first. Computer science, computer engineering, electrical and aerospace engineering, among others, are not available as a second choice.

For fall 2025, Illinois admitted 14,509 of 29,419 in-state applicants, 9,495 of 32,702 out-of-state applicants and 6,380 of 20,924 international applicants; 6,587 of the 9,207 enrolled first-years were Illinois residents.
Illinois Commitment covers full tuition and campus fees for Illinois residents with family income and assets of $75,000 or less each, for students admitted from fall 2025.

Tuition depends on the program: for a student starting in fall 2026, engineering and Gies business tuition is 18,740 for residents against a base rate of 13,252, which lifts the resident budget from 37,992 to 43,480.
The financial aid office publishes 2026-27 budgets by the term a student first enrolled (fall 2021 through fall 2026 starters each have their own table), because tuition is set by entry year.
For fall 2025, 4,317 students accepted a place on the waiting list and the Common Data Set reports 1 admitted from it.
